verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the background is cropped to a blurry, meaningless strip of fig and dark backdrop, so the hero food image is lost. The 'Perfect Taste' wreath is shrunk to a tiny badge in the middle, with a lot of dead space on the left and right. That headline is barely legible at this size and sits on the busy fig edge on the right. Neither candidate rearranges the layout for the wide banner shape.
